Complete [[Fort Ranik]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Push the invading [[Charr]] forces back to the [[Great Northern Wall]].
* *BONUS* Rescue [[Trooper Deeter Saberlin|Deeter Saberlin]] from the Charr.
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 15 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 22 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 37 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per the [[Fort Ranik#Walkthrough| Fort Ranik]] mission.

:''"[[Ascalon]]ian commanders are in trouble at [[Fort Ranik (outpost)|Fort Ranik]]. The Charr army has breached the Northern Wall and taken prisoners. Using any measures necessary, push back the invading Charr forces. For Ascalon!"''
